activity.notes: Zaynab was an influential political adviser and consort in the early Almoravid state. The chronology of her marriages and death is disputed. Around 1071 is retained only as a representative approximate point associated with her marriage and political partnership with Yusuf ibn Tashfin; no exact reign or fabricated lifelong co-rulership is asserted.
